# infisical_pki_sync_certificate (Resource)

Associate a certificate with a PKI sync so it is synced to the destination. The certificate must belong to the same application as the PKI sync.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

# Associate a certificate with a PKI sync so it is synced to the destination.
# The certificate must belong to the same application as the PKI sync.
resource "infisical_pki_sync_certificate" "example" {
  pki_sync_id    = infisical_pki_sync_aws_certificate_manager.example.id
  certificate_id = "<certificate-id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate_id` (String) The ID of the certificate to associate with the PKI sync.
- `pki_sync_id` (String) The ID of the PKI sync to associate the certificate with.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the certificate association.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import a certificate association using the composite ID "<pki_sync_id>:<certificate_id>"
terraform import infisical_pki_sync_certificate.example <pki_sync_id>:<certificate_id>
```
